text.en:
The Sitio of Maawi in Barangay Alos, Municipality of Alaminos, Province of Pangasinan, is
hereby separated from said barangay and constituted into a distinct and independent barangay of said
municipality, to be known as Barangay Maawi.

Barangay Maawi shall be bounded and described as follows:
"A proposed Barangay Maawi, being a portion of Barangay Alos, Municipality of Alaminos, Province of
Pangasinan, Island of Luzon, Bounded on the N., along line M.B.M. No. 14-B.B.M. No. 51 by Barangay
Balayang; on the N.E. at B.B.M. No. 51 by Barangay Bolaney and along line B.B.M. No. 51-B.B.M. No. 52
by Barangay Alos Norte; on the S.E. along line B.B.M. No. 52-B.B.M. No. 58-M.B.M. No. 12 M.B.M. No.
14, by the Municipality of Mabini. Beginning at a point marked M.B.M. No. 14 on the prepared proposed
Maawi Plan, being S. 36 deg., 47’W., 5,592.25 m. from BLLM No. 1, CAD-325-D Alaminos Cadastre;
thence S. 84 deg., 19’E., 836.28 m. to point B.B.M. No. 51; thence S. 27 deg., 00’E., 1422.56 m. to point
B.B.M. No. 52; thence S. 35 deg., 41’W., 1110.18 m. to point B.B.M. No. 58; thence N. 67 deg., 26’W.,
1216.96 m. to point M.B.M. No. 12; thence N. 09 deg., 20’E., 1807.19 m. to point of beginning, containing an
area of one hundred seventy three point nine thousand four hundred twenty-two hectares (173.9422). All
points referred to are indicated on the plan and market on the ground by M.B.M. No. 14, B.B.M. No. 51,
B.B.M. No. 52, B.B.M. No. 58 and M.B.M. No. 12. Bearings true, date prepared February 18, 1982."
